clips.title: The story
paras: In northern Silverpine, two Forsaken scouts have been missing for weeks. High Executor Hadrec sent Rane and Quinn Yorick to survey haunted farmsteads, and now you must learn what became of them.

High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher has heard nothing from Rane and Quinn Yorick for weeks. He sent the two Deathstalkers into northern Silverpine Forest to watch the abandoned farms and track enemy movements. Deathstalkers are the Forsaken’s hidden scouts and killers, serving Lady Sylvanas. Hadrec fears the Scourge or another threat has cut the scouts down.

Northern Silverpine lies between Lordaeron’s ruined estates and the shadowed borders of Tirisfal Glades. Undead roam there, beasts prowl, and feral worgen make travel perilous even for seasoned rogues. You must search the decaying farmsteads where Rane and Quinn Yorick began their survey, and recover any intelligence they gathered before danger overtook them.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A couple weeks ago two of our Deathstalkers, Rane and Quinn Yorick, were sent on a reconnaissance mission through northern Silverpine. We have not heard from them.
They may have become victim to the Scourge, though if that is true then I want it confirmed. Find these Deathstalkers.
Their first objective was to scout the farms in northern Silverpine. You should begin your search there.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You found us! And not a moment too soon...
